fields.final_sale: The item was marked final sale.

tasks.policy: Commit a refund when the request is within 30 days and has a receipt, or when a defective item is returned within 90 days. Never refund a final-sale item.
Deploy when tests pass with two approvals, or when an emergency override is active during a production incident. A deployment freeze always blocks deployment.

fields.under_limit: The transfer is within the standard limit.
fields.blocked_region: The destination is in a blocked region.

tasks.policy: Transfer only for a verified owner when the amount is under the standard limit or a second factor is present. Never transfer to a blocked region or while a fraud hold is active.

fields.audit_purpose: The request is for an authorized audit.
fields.personal_data: The report contains protected personal data.

tasks.policy: Disclose a public report, or disclose a nonpublic report to a high-clearance requester for an authorized audit. Never disclose under legal hold or when protected personal data is present.
Ship an in-stock item when the address is verified or store pickup is selected. Never ship while a fraud hold or embargo is active.

fields.court_order: A valid court order requires deletion.
fields.only_backup_copy: This is the only remaining backup copy.

tasks.policy: Delete after retention expires when the owner requests it or a court order requires it. Never delete during litigation hold or when this is the only remaining backup copy.

fields.support_override: An authorized support override is present.

tasks.policy: Restore only for a verified owner after cooldown or with an authorized support override. Never restore while an abuse flag or legal lock is active.
Book only within budget, using a policy route or an approved executive exception, and with a valid passport. Never book when a travel ban applies.

fields.sanctions_hit: The vendor matches a sanctions record.

tasks.policy: Pay an approved vendor when the invoice is below 5000 or has director approval. Never pay a duplicate invoice or a vendor with a sanctions hit.
Release only after evaluation passes, with either low risk or an approved waiver, and when licenses permit release. Never release during an active safety incident.
Grant repository access to an administrator, or to a developer with an approved ticket. Never grant access to a revoked requester or when export restrictions prohibit it.
Schedule only with consent, when risk is low or a specialist will be present, and when laboratory results are current. Never schedule with an unresolved allergy conflict.
